# Harvard Law School

> Harvard Law School's comprehensive resource hub for admissions, academics, and student services across J.D., LL.M., and S.J.D. degree programs.

Harvard Law School provides detailed information for prospective and current students, including admissions processes, financial aid, academic programs, curricula, and international opportunities. The school emphasizes experiential learning, the case method, and diverse practice areas through its comprehensive academic offerings.

## Key Topics

- J.D. Program
- LL.M. Program
- S.J.D. Program
- Case Method
- Admissions Process
- Financial Aid
- Clinical Programs
- Experiential Learning
- International Legal Studies
- Academic Policies
- Winter Term
- Graduate Programs
- Degree Requirements
- Course Catalog
- Student Services

## Admissions & Programs

- [Home](https://hls.harvard.edu): Harvard Law School homepage with admissions, academics, events, and news
- [J.D. Admissions](https://hls.harvard.edu/jdadmissions): J.D. admissions hub covering application process and prospective student info
- [Apply to Harvard Law School](https://hls.harvard.edu/jdadmissions/apply-to-harvard-law-school): J.D. program application process and requirements guide
- [Graduate Program](https://hls.harvard.edu/graduate-program): LL.M. and S.J.D. graduate program overview and admissions
- [Apply to the Graduate Program](https://hls.harvard.edu/graduate-program/graduate-program-admissions-and-financial-aid/apply-to-the-graduate-program): Graduate program (LL.M., S.J.D.) application procedures and deadlines
- [Why HLS?](https://hls.harvard.edu/why-hls): School overview highlighting student experience and diversity at HLS

## Academics & Curriculum

- [Academics](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics): Academic programs overview including J.D., LL.M., S.J.D., and curricula
- [Degree Programs](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics/degree-programs): Degree program options including J.D., LL.M., S.J.D., and joint degrees
- [Curriculum](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics/curriculum): Curriculum overview, course offerings, and clinical programs
- [Course Catalog](https://hls.harvard.edu/courses): Complete course catalog with faculty instructors and course listings
- [HLS Writes!](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics/writing-at-hls): Legal writing program, resources, and written work requirements
- [International Legal Studies](https://hls.harvard.edu/ils): International law studies, study abroad, and global opportunities
- [Winter Term](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics/winter-term): Winter term experiential learning, writing program, and opportunities
- [Areas of Interest Archive](https://hls.harvard.edu/areas-of-interest): Archive of legal practice areas and specialization options

## Financial Aid & Student Services

- [J.D. Student Financial Services](https://hls.harvard.edu/sfs): Student financial services, aid, and loan repayment information
- [The Need-Based Aid Philosophy](https://hls.harvard.edu/sfs/prospective-and-admitted-students/prospective-and-admitted-need-based-aid-philosophy): Need-based aid philosophy, LIPP program, and financial aid eligibility

## Academic Policies & Reference

- [Harvard Law School Handbook of Academic Policies](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics/harvard-law-school-handbook-of-academic-policies): Academic policies, degree requirements, and student handbook
- [Academic Calendar](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics/academic-calendar): Academic calendar with term schedules, exams, and holidays
- [Syllabi, Exam, and Course Evaluations](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics/curriculum/syllabi-exam-and-course-evaluations): Syllabi archive, exam materials, and course evaluations via HELIOS

## Optional

- [Fellowships and Prizes](https://hls.harvard.edu/academics/fellowships-and-prizes): Student fellowships, prizes, and award opportunities
